subject.title: Redesign usage share card around model activity

question: Should the share artifact remain a narrow, explicitly partial-safe summary until source-instance route identity and daily-coverage metadata are available, or should this PR expand the dashboard data contract to support its model/source claims?
rationale: The mechanical defects are fixable, but the permanent public contract for source identity, partial history, overflow language, and spend provenance belongs to the still-open product/design discussion rather than to an isolated layout change.

options.title: Narrow the card to proven data
options.body: Keep the redesign bounded to identities and coverage the existing payload can prove, and defer richer model/source claims until the contract is available.

options.title: Approve a richer contract first
options.body: Explicitly sponsor extending the shared data model for source-instance route identity, observed/displayable/hidden counts, and daily availability before implementing the card copy.

recommendation.title: Narrow the card to proven data
recommendation.body: Keep the redesign bounded to identities and coverage the existing payload can prove, and defer richer model/source claims until the contract is available.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the recent merged partial-history contract and are the strongest current-main routing candidate for the required product and data-truth decision.
